# Changelog - Emotion Beater 🧘
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-01-07
### Added
- Initial project structure with Expo and React Native.
- AI Integration using Groq (Llama-3.3-70b).
- Mood-based Poki game recommendations (Happy, Sad, Stressed, Angry, Bored, Excited).
- Evolutionary Avatar system (🌱 -> 🧘).
- Gamification elements: XP system, Leveling, and Daily Missions.
- Visual feedback with Confetti animations and Haptics.
- Private Analytics dashboard with Mood Frequency Map.
